Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/observe' task. The dark oak trapdoor is at spawn-relative (7, 0, 0), inside the enclosed room behind the fence gate. max_distance=4 ensures the player must have walked past the fence gate (at x=3) and entered the room to be close enough. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the trapdoor. This enforces the spatial dependency: the player cannot trigger this milestone without first passing through the gate area.

Inside the room, a dark oak trapdoor sits on a white quartz floor for high contrast visibility. Dirt path blocks guide the player from spawn toward the fence gate. Lanterns mark both the gate and the trapdoor locations.
task_text: Find the spruce fence gate, pass through it, and then find the dark oak trapdoor inside the enclosed room beyond.
design_notes: Player spawns at origin facing east. Dirt path at ~-3 to ~2 on z=0 guides player toward the fence gate at ~3,0,0. Fence line runs from z=-4 to z=4 at x=3. Open gate at z=0 allows passage. Room walls are spruce planks on 3 sides (east at x=10, north at z=-4, south at z=4). Quartz floor inside from x=5-9, z=-3 to 3 provides white contrast. Dark oak trapdoor at ~7,0,0 stands upright (open=true) on the quartz floor. Lanterns at both gate and trapdoor for lighting/visual cues.
